connectors.title: Weather alerts (NWS, by point)
connectors.description: active emergency alerts and weather warnings for the place (National Weather Service, US)
connectors.attribution: Alerts from the US National Weather Service (weather.gov)

connectors.title: Worldwide earthquakes, past day (USGS)
connectors.description: magnitude 2.5 or more earthquakes anywhere in the world in the past day, newest first; not tied to a place (USGS)
connectors.attribution: Earthquake data from the US Geological Survey (earthquake.usgs.gov), public domain

connectors.title: Earthquakes near the place (USGS)
connectors.description: recent earthquakes of magnitude 2 or more within 300 km of the place, newest first (USGS)
connectors.attribution: Earthquake data from the US Geological Survey (earthquake.usgs.gov), public domain

connectors.title: Wildfires near the place (WFIGS)
connectors.description: current wildfire incidents within 150 miles of the place, with size, containment and county (US, NIFC WFIGS)
connectors.attribution: Wildfire incidents from the National Interagency Fire Center WFIGS (data-nifc.opendata.arcgis.com), public domain

connectors.title: Wildfire perimeters near the place (WFIGS)
connectors.description: current wildfire perimeters within 150 miles of the place, with distance and direction from the place to the fire edge (US, NIFC WFIGS)
connectors.attribution: Wildfire perimeters from the National Interagency Fire Center WFIGS (data-nifc.opendata.arcgis.com), public domain

connectors.title: River flow and gage height, Idaho (USGS)
connectors.description: latest river discharge (cfs) and gage height (ft) at active USGS stream gages in Idaho; the same list for every place (USGS)
connectors.attribution: Water data from the US Geological Survey (waterservices.usgs.gov), public domain; provisional data is subject to revision
connectors.license: US Government work, public domain; provisional data subject to revision

connectors.title: Idaho 511 traffic events
connectors.description: statewide Idaho road events from 511: closures, crashes, incidents and roadwork, full closures first; the same list for every place; needs a free 511 developer key
connectors.attribution: Road event data from Idaho 511 (511.idaho.gov), Idaho Transportation Department; use is subject to the 511 developer terms

connectors.title: Idaho 511 winter road conditions
connectors.description: statewide Idaho winter road conditions from 511 (dry, wet, snow, ice, closed) by road section; the same list for every place; needs a free 511 developer key
connectors.attribution: Road condition data from Idaho 511 (511.idaho.gov), Idaho Transportation Department; use is subject to the 511 developer terms

connectors.title: Road work zones, Idaho (WZDx)
connectors.description: statewide Idaho road work zones and lane closures from the national WZDx feed, most restrictive first; the same list for every place
connectors.attribution: Work zone data from the Idaho Transportation Department (511.idaho.gov) in the USDOT WZDx format
connectors.license: Idaho Transportation Department open data (WZDx feed); see 511.idaho.gov terms

connectors.title: Space weather alerts (NOAA)
connectors.description: recent NOAA space weather alerts, watches and warnings (solar flares, radiation storms, geomagnetic storms, radio blackouts), newest first; not tied to a place
connectors.attribution: Space weather data from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (swpc.noaa.gov), US Government work

connectors.title: Solar flux F10.7 (NOAA)
connectors.description: 10.7 cm solar radio flux (a measure of solar activity that sets HF radio conditions), newest first; not tied to a place
connectors.attribution: Space weather data from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (swpc.noaa.gov), US Government work

connectors.title: Geomagnetic Kp index (NOAA)
connectors.description: planetary Kp index (geomagnetic activity, 0 quiet to 9 extreme storm), newest first, 3-hourly; not tied to a place
connectors.attribution: Space weather data from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (swpc.noaa.gov), US Government work

connectors.title: Space weather scales (NOAA)
connectors.description: current NOAA space weather scales (radio blackouts R, solar radiation storms S, geomagnetic storms G) and the 3-day outlook; not tied to a place
connectors.attribution: Space weather data from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (swpc.noaa.gov), US Government work

connectors.title: Traffic flow at the place (TomTom)
connectors.description: live traffic speed on the road segment nearest the place compared with free-flow speed, and whether the road is closed (TomTom; needs a free TomTom key)
connectors.attribution: Traffic data by TomTom (tomtom.com); use is subject to the TomTom developer terms
connectors.license: TomTom developer terms (free key, 2,500 requests/day free)

connectors.title: Weather forecast (Open-Meteo)
connectors.description: weather forecast for the place: current conditions and a 16-day outlook with highs, lows, rain chance, wind (Open-Meteo, worldwide)
